 This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

In this writ petition, the petitioners have sought for the following reliefs:
"(a) ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS DIRECTING THE RESPONDENT NO.2 TO CONSIDER THE APPLICATION FILED UNDER SECTION 28-A OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT AND DETERMINE THE AMOUNT OF COMPENSATION AT RS.800/- PER SQ FT WITH ALL STATUTORY BENEFITS AS PER THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD PASSED IN LAC.NO.77/2012 AND LAC NO.28/2013 IN SO FOR AS PETITIONERS LAND BEARING SY NO.83/1 MEASURING 0.19 GUNTAS AND LAND BEARING SY NO. 83/2 MEASURING 0.09 GUNTAS AND SY NO. NO.83/3 MEASURING 0.09 GUNTAS
ARE CONCERNED.

(b) ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS DIRECTING THE RESPONDENT AUTHORITY TO DISBURSE THE AMOUNT OF COMPENSATION WITH ALL STATUTORY BENEFITS."
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned HCGP for the respondents.
Perused the material on record.

3. It is the grievance of the petitioners that their application under Section 28-A of Land Acquisition Act, submitted to the 2nd respondent has not been considered so far by them nor any order has been passed on the same.
Under these circumstances, the petitioners are before this Court by way of the present petition.
4. Per contra, learned HCGP for the respondents submits that if reasonable time is given, they would consider and pass necessary orders on the said application.

5. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and rival submissions, respondent No.3-the Deputy Commissioner is directed to dispose off the application filed under Section 28-A of Land Acquisition Act by the petitioners in accordance with law, if not already disposed off, as expeditiously as possible within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed off.
